paraphrase: What is the all? The eye and forms, the ear and sounds, the nose and odours, the tongue and tastes, the body and tangibles, the mind and mental objects: this is called the all.

original.text: Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ? Cakkhuñceva rūpā ca, sotañca saddā ca, ghānañca gandhā ca, jivhā ca rasā ca, kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca, mano ca dhammā ca— idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ.

paraphrase: Whoever would say 'rejecting this all I shall make known another all' would only have empty talk; questioned, he could not reply, because it would be outside his domain.
